_doc: Per-episode continuity ledger for Arc I. Before scripting episode N, read the cumulative state through N-1 so dialogue never contradicts what is already known/owned/done. After scripting N, append its deltas. This is the cross-episode memory the system was missing.
twist_gate: NO multiverse / divergent-timeline language in Arc I. The crossing reads as future-humans -> empty world. Reveal lands mid-arc, not here.
world_facts_known_to_leads: They have crossed to an empty 'sterile' world (no other humans here).
The crossing exacts a toll: ringing ears, vascular headache, nosebleed, photosensitivity.
The Oracle (handheld AI) gives survival guidance but its altitude/atmosphere calibration is wrong here — Signe logs errors.
There is a mapped spring at the base of the north cliff.

relationships.Aldric-Cael: status contest: Aldric assumes command; Cael needles the gap between ranking tasks and doing them.
relationships.leads-Dimmed: leads depend on Dimmed competence (Brenn fire, Ysel water/food) without acknowledging it. Dimmed restraint holds: no one narrates the injustice.

episodes.title: The Crossing
beats_locked: Arrival on the plateau in punishing sun; crossing-sickness.
Competence inversion: Brenn lights fire in ~90s from grass the leads walked past; Aldric fails with the firesteel.
Signe logs Oracle error 001 (boiling-time miscalc at 60m).
Ysel moves to the fire with water containers, unasked.
knowledge_inserts: dry vs dew-damp grass for tinder

state_after.water: spring located by Aldric, not yet reached; ~2L/person on hand
state_after.shelter: none yet; flagged as tonight's priority
state_after.oracle_trust: Signe has begun an error log; trust conditional
